title: F2C2012:  Aaron Swartz keynote - "How we stopped SOPA"
summary: Aaron Swartz's keynote at Freedom to Connect 2012 describing how ordinary people helped defeat the SOPA censorship bill. He recounts how the Senate unexpectedly united behind the bill and how grassroots action stopped it.
why: HN shares it as an inspiring account of citizens changing Washington, especially after Swartz's death.

quote.text: If you haven't watched aaronsw's talk on stopping SOPA, it's well worth your time.
